import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/tests')
from harness import run, t, done

# JSON-level edge cases through the real main.py
import subprocess, json
def raw(text):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                       input=text.encode('utf-8'), capture_output=True)
    return [json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()]

inv = {'status':'invalid'}
t('bom', raw('\ufeff{"op":"about"}\n'), [inv])
